about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a software engineer and MSc Computer Science graduate from York University. My work combines Java/Spring Boot backend development with research on LLM agents, software security, and automated testing.
about.paragraph2: At DSi and on an external assignment with Synopsys, I worked on examination-management systems, payment integrations, and CI/CD tooling. During a university research collaboration with Huawei Canada, I developed components for repository-wide test generation and agent tracing and evaluation. My research includes SecVulEval, which received the Best Dataset & Benchmark Paper award at AIware 2026, and StaAgent, accepted in ACM TOSEM.
about.paragraph3: When I'm not working, you can find me traveling🌴, playing instruments🎸, or experimenting with new technologies🧑‍💻.
